claims.statement: Alarm lot LOT-1239 measured 519.47 on MET01, outside spec 485.0 to 515.0 with target 500.0
CLEAN splits lots CLN02 mean 513.98 vs CLN01 mean 500.4 with p-value 0.0002, while DEP p-value 0.211 and MET p-value 0.4191 show no split

CLN02 lots on different chambers all read high LOT-1230 on DEP01-A 521.21 and LOT-1232 on DEP02-B 520.27 and LOT-1235 on DEP02-A 519.84, while CLN01 lots LOT-1228 501.51 and LOT-1229 499.65 and LOT-1231 498.23 stayed near target
Alarm lot LOT-1239 ran CLEAN on CLN02 then DEP01-A and measured 519.47 on MET01
Multiple chambers show OOS in 24.0 hours DEP01-A 3 and DEP02-A 1 and DEP02-B 2, with DEP01-A mean 506.91 vs DEP01-B mean 500.82

disposition.summary: CLN02 lots read about 14 thick across all DEP chambers and both MET tools since 68.4h, while CLN01 lots stayed on target. Alarm lot LOT-1239 is a CLN02 lot and is OOS. Hold the lot and escalate CLN02; chambers and metrology are fine.

sources.practitioner: Equipment or upstream problems are suspected when abnormal lots cluster in one group. One contact called upstream and shared-facility effects very frequent; the other thought them rare. We keep the scenario and note the disagreement.
